hook: $60 an hour still leaves you $12,660 short
hook_say: Charge $60 an hour and you still end the year $12,660 short of a $60,000 take-home.

rows.label: Take-home pay you want
rows.why: The calculator's example goal: $60,000 a year after tax and costs.

rows.label: The rate you charge
rows.why: Type any rate into the check line. Here it is $60.

rows.label: Paid hours (60% of 1,920 worked)
rows.say: Clients pay for 1,152 of your 1,920 hours
rows.why: 48 weeks of 40 hours is 1,920 hours worked. At 60% billable, clients pay for 1,152 of them.

rows.label: $6,000 costs + 25% tax set-aside
rows.why: $6,000 of yearly business costs plus a 25% tax set-aside of $15,780.

rows.label: What you take home
rows.why: $69,120 less $21,780. That is $24.66 for each hour you actually work.

rows.label: Short of your $60,000
rows.why: The check line says it plainly: short of your take-home goal by $12,660 a year.

fix.label: Hourly rate for $60,000
fix.why: $86,000 of revenue needed over 1,152 paid hours: $74.65 an hour, $75 on a rate card.
